note: Cases for the shared host-call collector. The collected calls and the facts are what the same program and the installed operator table give when walked in the Rust each_call_of order (parent before children, guard before effects, transitions before ticks); the facts case also checks the keys and words indexes of the params by path.

cases.id: a failed table read answers unread with no facts
a request before the table is read waits and is answered by the drain
the waiting request runs once the table is loaded
an incompatible language scan fails the read
a scan with no std root fails the read
a compatible scan reads the std manifest
